# GitHub Copilot on nanopnp

You are not Claude Code. Follow CLAUDE.md, which is normative, and read `.claude/workflow/hosts.md`
before a workflow command (`/np-plan`, `/np-implement`, `/np-ship`, `/np-gui`, the steward), a commit
or a push: it maps each Claude Code tool those files name to its substitute here, and says which
checks are still to be run by hand.

Commit and push only with `git` in a shell command, so the gate runs: never by typing into a running
shell, with GitHub's file tools or with the app's Commit and Push buttons.
